use.flag: Enable X11 backend support via libxkbcommon-x11 and XCB
Enable Wayland backend support (KWin D-Bus, Sway, Hyprland)

pkgmetadata.longdescription: A lightweight LXQt panel plugin for switching keyboard layouts. Supports X11 (via libxkbcommon-x11 + XCB) and Wayland (KWin, Sway, Hyprland). Features include click-to-switch widget, context menu with layout list, and desktop notifications on layout change.
